expectations.text: Recommends Playwright DOM capture (document.documentElement.outerHTML) over wget or HTTrack
expectations.evidence: Response explicitly states: 'Traditional approaches like wget --mirror or HTTrack won't work... The approach that works: Playwright DOM capture + manual asset download' and shows browser_evaluate with outerHTML

expectations.text: Mentions searching JS files for CDN base URL variables, not just grepping for full URLs
expectations.evidence: Response explicitly describes the base URL variable pattern: 'var vQ = "https://cdn.stripe.com/v3/fingerprinted/assets"' and explains 'You must download the JS bundles, grep for the CDN domain to find the base variable, then find all concatenations'

expectations.text: Warns about referrer-protected CDNs and recommends verifying file sizes (e.g. wc -c)
expectations.evidence: Phase 1 shows explicit curl test with and without Referer header and wc -c to check file sizes

expectations.text: Recommends using absolute paths (/css/, /js/) rather than relative paths
expectations.evidence: Response states: 'Use absolute paths (/assets/...), not relative ones. This is critical for subdirectory pages.'

expectations.text: Covers multiple phases of the cloning process in logical order
expectations.evidence: Response covers all 8 phases in order: Reconnaissance, HTML Capture, Asset Discovery, URL Rewriting, Corruption Repair, CSS Restoration, Routing, Validation

expectations.text: Mentions repairing Playwright JSON pipeline corruption artifacts
expectations.evidence: Phase 5 includes the full repair Python script covering JSON wrapper, escaped quotes, literal \t sequences, and broken @media tags
